snippet.title: KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I ~ III] Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy the KINGDOM HEARTS series on Nintendo Switch™ 2, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 8, 2026!

Learn more at: https://www.square-enix.com/kingdomhearts/collection

KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I ~ III] is a bundle value package that includes three titles:

KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX
KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)
*these titles can also be purchased seperately

Play a demo version of KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) on Nintendo Switch™ 2, available now.

EPIC Games offers the KINGDOM HEARTS series as title packages but not as a collection.
